preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n integers in the b array and p permutation, where n is the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All elements in b and p are integers between 1 and n (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(b[i] == i+1 for i in range(n) if b[i] == i+1).count(True) == 1
preconditions.description: The b array encodes a rooted tree with exactly one root (b[i] == i+1 for exactly one i).
The permutation p contains all vertices from 1 to n exactly once.
The number of vertices n in each test case satisfies 1 ≤ n ≤ 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: any(output_line.strip() == '-1' or (len(output_line.split()) == n and all(0 <= int(w) <= 10**9 for w in output_line.split())), for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' (no solution) or an array of n integers w_i (0 ≤ w_i ≤ 10^9), where w_i is the weight of the edge from b_i to i (or 0 if i is the root).

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p[i]] < dist[p[i+1]] for i in range(n-1)) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the distances from the root to vertices, computed as the sum of edge weights along the path from the root, must satisfy dist[p[i]] < dist[p[i+1]] for all i from 0 to n-2, where p is the given permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[u] != dist[v] for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(1, n+1) if u != v) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all vertices must have distinct distances from the root (no two vertices can have the same distance).

postconditions.expression: all(w_i == 0 or w_i >= 1 for w_i in map(int, output_line.split())) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all non-root edge weights w_i must be positive integers (1 ≤ w_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: any(output_line.strip() == '-1' or (all(dist[u] == sum(w_i for i in path_to_root(u)) for u in range(1, n+1)) and sorted(dist.values()) == [dist[p[i]] for i in range(n)]), for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the computed distances from the root must match the permutation p when sorted in ascending order, where dist[u] is the sum of edge weights along the path from the root to u.
